BSplineSketch.description:
Closed periodic B-spline interpolating through `fit_points`.

Built via `GeomAPI_Interpolate(points, PeriodicFlag=True, tol)`.
BSplineSketch.title: BSplineSketch

CompositeSketch.description:
Closed loop made of line/arc/spline segments.

Segments are validated to form a closed chain: end of segment i must equal
start of segment i+1 (within EPS_CLOSE), and last.end == first.start.
CompositeSketch.title: CompositeSketch

LissajousCurveSketch.description:
Closed Lissajous figure (shorthand for a common parametric curve).

x(t) = amp_x · sin(freq_x · t + phase)
y(t) = amp_y · sin(freq_y · t)
t ∈ [0, 2π].

With integer freq_x / freq_y and a non-zero phase the curve is closed
(lobes form a figure 8 / star). Always built as a periodic spline.
LissajousCurveSketch.title: LissajousCurveSketch

ParametricCurveSketch.description:
Parametric curve x(t), y(t) sampled in [t_min, t_max].

Both `x_expr` and `y_expr` are simpleeval expressions in variable `t`.
Allowed funcs: sin/cos/tan/exp/sqrt/abs; consts: pi, e.
The sampled points are interpolated as a periodic B-spline if
`close_curve` is True (typical for closed-loop sketches), otherwise as a
non-periodic spline whose first/last endpoints will be auto-closed with a
short tangent segment by the wire builder.
ParametricCurveSketch.title: ParametricCurveSketch

PolarCurveSketch.description:
Polar curve r(theta) sampled in [theta_min, theta_max].

`r_expr` is a simpleeval expression in variable `theta`. The sampled
points (x = r·cos θ, y = r·sin θ) are always closed (periodic spline).
PolarCurveSketch.title: PolarCurveSketch

PolygonSketch.description:
Closed polygon defined by ≥3 vertices. Last vertex auto-connects to first.

`corner_fillet_r` > 0 applies a uniform 2D fillet on every vertex via
BRepFilletAPI_MakeFillet2d.
PolygonSketch.title: PolygonSketch

SlotSketch.description:
Capsule shape: two semicircular end caps joined by two straight lines.

`length_mm` is the overall length including end caps.
`width_mm` is the diameter of the end caps (also the slot width).
SlotSketch.title: SlotSketch

skills.name: text_emboss
skills.summary: Emboss Unicode text on a planar face by extruding glyph outlines outward along the face normal and fusing with the body. Standard raised logo/label (e.g., 'iPhone' on the rear housing).

skills.name: antenna_slit
skills.summary: Linear thin slit for antenna isolation on metallic unibody. Cuts through the body along start→end with a narrow rectangular cross-section. v1: linear path only. v2: curve sweep + multi-segment.

depth_mm.description: 슬릿 깊이 (body 의 Z 두께를 넘으면 through)
depth_mm.title: Depth Mm

skills.name: polymer_inlay
skills.summary: Fill an antenna slit with polymer inlay (union). Geometry identical to antenna_slit. v1 returns the unified body; v2 will track material attribute.

skills.name: chamfer_edges_by_predicate
skills.summary: Apply a constant-width 45° chamfer to edges matching a selector predicate.

skills.name: fillet_edges_by_predicate
skills.summary: Apply a constant-radius fillet to edges matching a selector predicate.

skills.name: loft_side_profile
skills.summary: Loft a solid between two 2D sections (top + bottom). v1 supports circle→circle, rectangle→rectangle. Sections must be same kind.

skills.name: surface_offset
skills.summary: Uniform surface offset of the entire body (thickness change). Positive = expand outward, negative = shrink inward. Note: large offsets can fail due to self-intersection.

offset_mm.description: 외각 offset (mm). 양수 = 확장, 음수 = 축소.
offset_mm.title: Offset Mm

skills.name: swept_relief
skills.summary: Linear swept relief (cutout) — rectangular cross-section swept along a straight path. v1: straight path only. v2: arbitrary curve path.

skills.name: variable_radius_fillet
skills.summary: Apply per-edge different fillet radii. Edges from selector × radii list. If radii has fewer entries, it cycles. Edges sorted by bbox-center lexicographic for stable assignment.

radii_mm.description: R list. edges 수보다 적으면 cycle.
radii_mm.title: Radii Mm

skills.name: chamfer_asymmetric
skills.summary: Apply an asymmetric chamfer to edges matching a selector predicate. distance_1 is measured along one adjacent face, distance_2 along the other. The resulting chamfer face is rectangular (elongated) rather than the square produced by a symmetric chamfer.

skills.name: face_face_fillet
skills.summary: Blend between two faces with a constant-radius fillet. If the two faces share an edge, fillets that edge directly. If they are non-adjacent, finds the bridging face(s) between them and fillets the edges on those bridges that touch either selected face. FALLBACK: this is an edge-based approximation of a true Geom-surface face-face blend (OCP's ChFi3d_FilBuilder is not stably exposed); the visible result matches the standard sharp-edge case.

skills.name: deburring
skills.summary: Auto-detect sharp internal/external corners (dihedral deviation > 60 deg) and apply a tiny fillet (≤ 0.2 mm). No-op if no sharp corners exist. Use as a conservative finish before final_fillet.

max_radius_mm.description: 자동 deburr fillet 의 최대 R (작게 권장).
max_radius_mm.title: Max Radius Mm

min_deviation_deg.description: 이 deviation 이상이면 sharp 로 간주.
min_deviation_deg.title: Min Deviation Deg

skills.name: final_fillet_all_sharp_edges
skills.summary: Apply a small uniform fillet to all 'sharp' edges (angle below threshold). Edges that fail individually are skipped — partial fillet OK.

min_angle_deg.description: 이 각도 이하면 sharp 로 간주
min_angle_deg.title: Min Angle Deg

skills.name: sanding_pass
skills.summary: Apply a uniform tiny fillet (default 0.1 mm) to ALL convex edges, as if sanding the outside corners. Concave edges and smooth/tangent edges are skipped. No-op if the body has no convex edges.

radius_mm.description: 모든 convex edge 에 일괄 적용할 미세 R (sanding 흉내).
radius_mm.title: Radius Mm

skills.name: surface_finish_tag
skills.summary: Attach surface-finish metadata (polish/matte/texture_a/texture_b + target Ra in µm) to faces matched by a selector. Geometry is NOT changed — pure metadata for downstream DFM / process planning.

target_ra_um.description: 목표 Ra (μm). polish: 0.05~0.4, matte: 0.4~1.6, texture_a/b: 1.6~12.5 권장.
target_ra_um.title: Target Ra Um

skills.name: helical_thread_external
skills.summary: Cut a real external (male) helical V-thread on a cylindrical region of the body. Builds a helix wire, sweeps a triangular V-profile along it, and subtracts. NOT a decorative engraving — produces a true 3D thread groove manufacturable on a thread mill or lathe.

skills.name: helical_thread_internal
skills.summary: Cut a real internal (female) helical V-thread inside an existing cylindrical hole. Builds a helix wire, sweeps a V-profile whose apex points OUTWARD into the wall, and subtracts. Requires the hole to be pre-drilled at the same axis/radius (e.g. via `hole`).

skills.name: swept_pocket_along_curve
skills.summary: Sweep a 2D profile along a 3D polyline or B-spline path and subtract the resulting tube from the body. Used for curved channels, ergonomic finger grooves, cable trays, decorative grooves that follow a free-form curve.

skills.name: text_engrave
skills.summary: Engrave Unicode text into a planar face by extruding glyph outlines along the inward face normal and subtracting from the body. Standard logo/label engraving (e.g., 'SAMSUNG' on the back housing).

skills.name: circular_pattern
skills.summary: Repeat a circular feature (pocket | hole | boss) around an axis on the selected face. Full 360° ring or partial arc.

skills.name: linear_pattern
skills.summary: Repeat a circular feature (pocket | hole | boss) in a row along X or Y with constant spacing. Starts from a face-local offset.

skills.name: mirror_about_two_planes
skills.summary: Apply a circular feature then reflect across TWO orthogonal world planes (e.g. XZ + YZ) → 4-quadrant symmetric instances.

skills.name: mirror_feature
skills.summary: Strict 2-feature mirror — apply a circular feature once at the given face-local origin and once at its reflection across a world plane (XY | YZ | XZ).

skills.name: nested_pattern
skills.summary: Pattern of patterns — compose two sub-patterns (linear|circular) to produce outer_count × inner_count feature instances.

skills.name: path_pattern
skills.summary: Distribute a circular feature evenly along a polyline path (chord-length parameterization). Endpoints always included.

skills.name: variable_pattern
skills.summary: Linear array where each instance scales and rotates by a linear law (start→end). Produces tapered rows or fan arrays.

skills.name: cross_section
skills.summary: Compute the intersection curve of the body with a plane (BRepAlgoAPI_Section). Returns sampled polylines per edge. Read-only — body unchanged.

skills.name: find_features
skills.summary: Heuristically detect features (hole/pocket/fillet/chamfer) on the body. LLM hint, not ground truth. boss/rib are punted.

skills.name: inspect_geometry
skills.summary: Read-only inspection of a body — volume, bbox, face/edge inventory with surface types and normals. Result is attached to result.extras['inspection_report']; body is returned unchanged.

skills.name: measure
skills.summary: Measure distance (mm) or angle (deg) between two entities (face_center / edge_midpoint / vertex / bbox_center / point). Read-only — body unchanged.

skills.name: selector_preview
skills.summary: Dry-run a selector against the body and report what it matched (count + per-entity center/area/length/surface_type). On any error (zero match, NotImplementedError, etc.) returns diagnostic info instead of crashing.

skills.name: silhouette
skills.summary: Project all body edges onto the plane perpendicular to view_direction (camera → body). Returns 2D polylines per edge (brute projection — hidden/visible not distinguished). Read-only — body unchanged.

skills.name: symmetry_axes
skills.summary: Heuristically detect approximate symmetry planes of the body (X = x_center plane, etc.). Returns axes where ≥90% of faces have a mirror partner. Read-only — body unchanged.

skills.name: add_component
skills.summary: Add a named component (from an external STEP file or the current body) into a multi-body assembly compound, optionally translated/rotated.

source_step_path.description: 추가할 STEP 파일 경로. None 이면 현재 body 를 그대로 사용.
source_step_path.title: Source Step Path

rotation_axis_deg.description: (axis_x, axis_y, axis_z, theta_deg) — axis 가 (0,0,0) 이면 회전 없음.
rotation_axis_deg.title: Rotation Axis Deg

skills.name: interference_check
skills.summary: Check pairwise boolean overlap of components in a multi-body assembly. Returns each overlapping pair's volume in result.extras['interferences'].

pair_filter.description: 검사할 (a,b) 이름 쌍. None 이면 모든 pair 검사.
pair_filter.title: Pair Filter

skills.name: mate_planar
skills.summary: Planar mate: transform component_a so that face_a lies parallel to face_b (anti-parallel normals) at a given offset. Other components are preserved.

skills.name: move_component
skills.summary: Translate and/or rotate a named component inside a multi-body assembly. Other components are preserved.

rotation_axis_deg.description: (axis_x, axis_y, axis_z, theta_deg). axis (0,0,0) 또는 theta=0 이면 회전 없음.
rotation_axis_deg.title: Rotation Axis Deg

skills.name: bom_extract
skills.summary: Extract a bill-of-materials from a multi-body assembly — each component's axis-aligned bbox and volume in result.extras['bom']. Body unchanged.

skills.name: fastener_array
skills.summary: Populate N positions with copies of the same fastener (e.g. a screw). Each copy becomes a named component in the assembly compound.

positions.description: 복제 위치 list. 각 (x, y, z) 마다 한 개의 fastener 인스턴스 생성.
positions.title: Positions

fastener_step_path.description: fastener STEP 파일 경로. None 이면 현재 body 를 template 로 사용.
fastener_step_path.title: Fastener Step Path

rotation_axis_deg.description: (ax, ay, az, theta_deg) — 모든 인스턴스에 같은 회전 적용.
rotation_axis_deg.title: Rotation Axis Deg

skills.name: mate_at_distance
skills.summary: Planar mate with explicit distance: face_a aligned anti-parallel to face_b and offset by distance_mm along face_b's outward normal.

distance_mm.description: face_b outward normal 방향 거리 (mm). 음수 가능.
distance_mm.title: Distance Mm

skills.name: mate_axis
skills.summary: Axis mate: align two linear edges so their (infinite) axes coincide. Component_a is rigidly transformed; component_b is preserved.

skills.name: mate_concentric
skills.summary: Concentric mate: align two cylindrical faces so their axes coincide. Component_a is rigidly transformed; component_b is preserved.

skills.name: bspline_surface
skills.summary: Create a NURBS (B-spline) surface fit through a rectangular grid of 3D points. Optionally thicken into a solid. Used as a freeform shell, lens-blank surface, or as input to curved-floor pockets.

skills.name: coil_spring_rectangular
skills.summary: Solid coil spring with RECTANGULAR wire cross-section (width × thickness) swept along a helix. Rectangle thickness is radial; width is axial.

skills.name: cone
skills.summary: Raw cone/frustum primitive. r1=lower, r2=upper; at least one > 0.

skills.name: cylinder
skills.summary: Raw cylinder primitive. Center on (cx, cy, base_z), height along chosen axis (X/Y/Z).

skills.name: gear_external_involute
skills.summary: External spur gear with kinematically correct involute tooth profile. Standard module/pressure-angle parameterization (ISO). Optional central bore.

skills.name: gear_internal_involute
skills.summary: Internal (ring) gear with involute tooth profile pointing inward. Outer boundary is a circle; inner boundary carries n_teeth involute teeth.

skills.name: gyroid_lattice
skills.summary: Gyroid TPMS lattice (sphere-bead approximation of the zero-isosurface). Self-supporting, periodic, used for lightweight infill and heat exchangers.

skills.name: helical_spring
skills.summary: Solid coil spring: circular wire cross-section swept along a helix. Standard kinematic parameters (coil radius, wire radius, pitch, turns).

skills.name: prism_n_sided
skills.summary: Regular n-sided prism. Vertices on circumscribed circle of given radius.

skills.name: sphere
skills.summary: Raw sphere primitive at given center. Optional partial sphere via lat/long angles.

skills.name: torus
skills.summary: Raw torus primitive. major_radius > minor_radius. Optional partial (angle_deg).

skills.name: voronoi_lattice
skills.summary: Random Voronoi-cell strut lattice inside a bounding box. Uses scipy for true Voronoi when available; otherwise falls back to a nearest-neighbour strut network (documented approximation).

skills.name: wedge
skills.summary: Raw wedge primitive. dx/dy/dz extents + ltx (top X length). Origin at (0,0,0) + offset.

skills.name: curvature_map
skills.summary: Sample a UV grid on each matched face and compute local Gaussian / mean / principal curvature via BRepLProp_SLProps. Read-only — body unchanged.

skills.name: gdt_circularity
skills.summary: GD&T circularity (roundness): sample a circular edge, fit a best-fit circle (plane via SVD, circle via Kasa LS), report max radial deviation vs tolerance_mm. Read-only — body unchanged.

skills.name: gdt_cylindricity
skills.summary: GD&T cylindricity: fit a cylinder to the matched face and report max radial deviation vs tolerance_mm. Uses OCCT analytic cylinder when surface is exactly cylindrical, else SVD point fit. Read-only — body unchanged.

skills.name: gdt_flatness
skills.summary: GD&T flatness: sample the face, fit a best-fit plane (SVD), and report max perpendicular deviation vs tolerance_mm. Read-only — body unchanged.

skills.name: gdt_parallelism
skills.summary: GD&T parallelism: angle between two planar face normals vs 0° (or 180°, treated as equivalent). Deviation = min(angle, 180−angle). Read-only — body unchanged.

skills.name: gdt_perpendicularity
skills.summary: GD&T perpendicularity: angle between two planar face normals vs 90°. Deviation = |angle − 90|. Read-only — body unchanged.

skills.name: gdt_position
skills.summary: GD&T true-position: actual hole-axis XY vs target_xy. Deviation is radial offset; diametral zone = 2 × offset, compared to tolerance_mm (ASME Y14.5 diameter zone). Read-only — body unchanged.

skills.name: hole_alignment_check
skills.summary: Find all cylindrical faces, group by parallel axes, and check coaxiality within each group. Returns per-group alignment + per-hole distance-from-axis. Read-only — body unchanged.

skills.name: mass_properties
skills.summary: Compute volume (mm³), centroid, inertia matrix, and mass (g) of a body via GProp_GProps. Density input is in g/cm³ (default 1.0 — mass = volume_cm3). Read-only — body unchanged.

skills.name: mesh_quality
skills.summary: Tessellate (if needed) and report mesh-quality metrics: non-manifold edge count, degenerate triangle count, edge-length and angle extrema, boundary edge count. Body unchanged.

linear_deflection_mm.description: Used only when force_remesh=True or no existing mesh.
linear_deflection_mm.title: Linear Deflection Mm

force_remesh.description: If True, always re-tessellate even if a mesh exists.
force_remesh.title: Force Remesh

degenerate_area_tol_mm2.description: Triangles with area below this are flagged degenerate.
degenerate_area_tol_mm2.title: Degenerate Area Tol Mm2

skills.name: section_multi_plane
skills.summary: Compute intersection curves of the body with multiple planes (one BRepAlgoAPI_Section per plane). Returns sampled polylines per plane. Read-only — body unchanged.

skills.name: surface_area_by_region
skills.summary: For each region selector, resolve matched faces and sum surface areas. Returns per-region area + total. Read-only — body unchanged.

skills.name: datum_plane_assign
skills.summary: Label one or more faces as datum planes (A/B/C/...) for GD&T reference frame. Records face center, normal, and area in extras['datums'][label]. Read-only — body unchanged.

skills.name: edge_to_edge_distance
skills.summary: Minimum distance between two selected edges via BRepExtrema_DistShapeShape. If either selector matches multiple edges, the global minimum pair is reported. Read-only — body unchanged.

skills.name: hole_to_hole_distance
skills.summary: Detect all cylindrical faces on the body and report pairwise axis-line distances. For parallel pairs uses point-to-line distance; for skew pairs uses common-perpendicular distance. Read-only — body unchanged.

skills.name: section_at_centroid
skills.summary: Compute a section through the body's centroid along X/Y/Z (default: longest bounding-box axis). Returns sampled polylines per intersection edge. Read-only — body unchanged.

skills.name: tolerance_stack
skills.summary: 1-D tolerance stack analysis from a dimension chain. Computes worst-case (linear sum) and RSS (statistical) ± bounds plus per-dimension tuples. Read-only — body unchanged.

skills.name: brep_export
skills.summary: Write the current body to an OCCT-native .brep file via BRepTools.Write_s. Lossless — round-trip preserves full B-rep topology. Body is returned unchanged.

skills.name: brep_import
skills.summary: Load an OCCT-native .brep file as the body via BRepTools.Read_s + BRep_Builder. Lossless interchange format — preserves full B-rep topology and tolerances.

skills.name: iges_export
skills.summary: Write the current body to an IGES (.igs/.iges) file via IGESControl_Writer. Read-only: body is returned unchanged.

skills.name: iges_import
skills.summary: Load an IGES (.igs/.iges) file as the body via IGESControl_Reader. Used to ingest legacy CAD geometry (surfaces or solids) from CATIA V4 / NX / older tools.

path.description: IGES 파일 경로 (.igs/.iges), 절대 또는 cwd-relative

skills.name: step_export_v2
skills.summary: Write the current body to a STEP file with configurable schema (AP203 / AP214 / AP242) and optional color preservation via STEPCAFControl_Writer. Body is returned unchanged.

skills.summary: Tessellate the body and write it to an STL file. Read-only — body is returned unchanged; only the filesystem is touched.

skills.summary: Load an STL mesh file as the body. Result is a faceted shape (not a closed solid); good for inspection / visualization / re-export but unreliable for boolean ops.

skills.summary: Tessellate body and write a binary STL, then attach mesh stats (triangle count, vertex count, surface area) to extras['mesh_stats']. Body is returned unchanged.

skills.name: mesh_simplify
skills.summary: Decimate an STL mesh via vertex-cluster (grid-snap) simplification and write the reduced mesh to a new STL. Body is returned unchanged. Output triangle ratio approximates `target_ratio` but exact count depends on mesh topology.

target_ratio.description: Target fraction of original triangle count (0.5 = ~half). Cluster grid is sized from this ratio.

skills.summary: Convert an STL mesh into a BREP shell/solid by sewing per-triangle faces. Best-effort: works on small (≤10k triangles), reasonably manifold meshes. Open or non-manifold meshes yield an open shell.

max_triangles.title: Max Triangles

skills.name: battery_dock_pad
skills.summary: Flat battery-dock pad + 2 parallel contact ribs along its length. Pad seats the battery; ribs press against the terminals. v1 supports planar +Z/-Z target faces.

position_xy.title: Position Xy

length_mm.description: pad length along world X (rib axis)
length_mm.title: Length Mm

skills.name: cable_clip
skills.summary: Small L-shaped cable clip — a vertical wall + overhanging lip — attached to a planar face. Cable nests in the L corner and is retained by the lip. v1 supports planar +Z/-Z target faces.

position_xy.description: face-local (x, y) of clip corner (anchor of vertical wall)
position_xy.title: Position Xy

opening_width_mm.description: cable-cavity width (Y) and lip overhang depth (X)
opening_width_mm.title: Opening Width Mm

skills.name: embossed_pattern
skills.summary: Repeating raised pattern (grip dots, parallel lines, checker squares) on a planar face. Standard for tactile grip zones on phone backs, controller grips, watch crowns.

skills.name: gusset
skills.summary: Triangular reinforcement web between two perpendicular planar faces. Right-triangle prism extruded along the shared (axis-aligned) edge. Cathetes lie in the two face planes.

position_along_edge_mm.description: offset from the natural midpoint along the shared edge
position_along_edge_mm.title: Position Along Edge Mm

skills.name: heat_stake_boss
skills.summary: Heat-stake boss = cylindrical shaft + outward-tapered crown at the top, ready for hot-tool flaring against a mating part. v1 supports planar +Z/-Z target faces.

center_x_mm.description: face-local X offset from face center
center_x_mm.title: Center X Mm

center_y_mm.description: face-local Y offset from face center
center_y_mm.title: Center Y Mm

crown_chamfer_deg.description: outward chamfer angle of the crown — 0 = flat top extension, larger = wider flare
crown_chamfer_deg.title: Crown Chamfer Deg

skills.name: heatsink_fin
skills.summary: Thin rectangular heatsink fin attached to a planar face. Optional top_taper_mm narrows the top edge along the length axis for mold release. v1 supports +Z/-Z target faces.

center_x_mm.description: face-local X offset from face center
center_x_mm.title: Center X Mm

center_y_mm.description: face-local Y offset from face center
center_y_mm.title: Center Y Mm

top_taper_mm.title: Top Taper Mm

skills.name: hinge_pin_boss
skills.summary: Cylindrical hinge-pin boss with axial through-hole and N radial alignment notches around the perimeter (anti-rotation features). v1 supports planar +Z/-Z target faces.

notch_count.description: number of radial alignment notches (0 disables notch cut)
notch_count.title: Notch Count

notch_depth_mm.description: radial depth of each notch into the wall
notch_depth_mm.title: Notch Depth Mm

skills.name: standoff
skills.summary: PCB-mount standoff = hollow cylindrical boss (outer + concentric inner hole) with optional top taper (draft) for injection-mold ejection. v1 supports planar +Z/-Z target faces.

center_x_mm.description: face-local X offset from face center
center_x_mm.title: Center X Mm

center_y_mm.description: face-local Y offset from face center
center_y_mm.title: Center Y Mm

taper_deg.description: outward top taper for ejection draft; 0 = straight cylinder, >0 = upper radius shrinks
taper_deg.title: Taper Deg

skills.name: chamfer_conic
skills.summary: Apply a conic (bulged) chamfer to selected edges. conic_param ρ∈[0,1] controls the cross-section: 0=straight, 0.5=tangent, 1=quarter-circle. v0 approximates the bulge by widening the flat chamfer; a true conic patch is future work.

skills.name: chamfer_distance_angle
skills.summary: Apply a distance-angle chamfer to selected edges. distance is measured along the first adjacent face and angle is measured from that face into the chamfer. Internally converted to a two-distance chamfer (d, d·tan(angle)).

angle_deg.description: angle from first face into chamfer
angle_deg.title: Angle Deg

skills.name: chamfer_two_distance
skills.summary: Apply a two-distance chamfer to selected edges. distance1 is measured along the first adjacent face, distance2 along the second. Matches the canonical CAD-tool 'Two Distance' chamfer.

skills.name: shell_variable_thickness
skills.summary: Hollow a solid into a shell with per-face thickness. Faces in the thickness map are walled at the given thickness; other faces are either removed (open) or take a default thickness. Useful for enclosures whose camera deck or back cover must be thicker than the side walls.

skills.name: surface_blend_g1
skills.summary: G1-tangent surface blend between two faces (possibly non-adjacent). Builds a new spline surface (via BRepFill_Filling) anchored on the boundary edges of A and B, tangent to both faces. Returns a Face (surface body); use surface_thicken_variable to make solid.

skills.name: surface_blend_g2
skills.summary: G2 curvature-continuous surface blend between two faces. Builds a new spline surface (via BRepFill_Filling) that matches the tangent plane AND principal curvatures of A and B along their boundary edges. Stricter than surface_blend_g1; fails if filler can't converge — caller may fall back to G1.

skills.name: surface_extend_tangent
skills.summary: Extend a face along one of its boundary edges by `distance_mm`, tangent (G1) to the source face. Picks the longest boundary edge by default and builds a quadrilateral extension patch via BRepFill_Filling. Returns the new face (surface body).

skills.name: surface_split_with_curve
skills.summary: Split a single face by a polyline curve that lies on the face. Projects each point onto the face's surface, builds a polyline compound of edges, and applies BRepFeat_SplitShape so the source face is partitioned into ≥2 sub-faces.

points.description: Polyline of ≥2 XYZ points; projected onto the face.
points.title: Points

skills.name: surface_thicken_variable
skills.summary: Fit a NURBS surface through a point grid and thicken it into a solid by displacing each control point along its surface normal by a per-point thickness. Used for freeform shells whose wall thickness varies — e.g., a phone back cover thicker in the middle, thinner at the rim.

thickness_map.description: rows × cols positive thickness in mm
thickness_map.title: Thickness Map

skills.name: variable_radius_fillet_with_law
skills.summary: Apply a fillet with radius that varies SMOOTHLY ALONG each matched edge according to a user-supplied law r(t), t∈[0,1]. Laws: linear, polynomial, sin, or arbitrary expression. Uses OCCT's TColgp_Array1OfPnt2d (u,r) sampling for the radius-evolution API.

skills.name: vertex_chamfer
skills.summary: Chamfer a single vertex (corner) by cutting it off with a plane positioned distance_mm from the vertex along the average of incident edge directions.

vertex_position.description: approximate (x,y,z) of vertex to chamfer; nearest is used
vertex_position.title: Vertex Position

skills.name: cooling_channel_path
skills.summary: Drill straight-line cooling channels through the mold body. Each consecutive pair in path_seed_points is connected by a cylindrical bore of channel_d_mm diameter cut from the body. target_distance_to_cavity_mm is an engineering intent recorded to extras['cooling_report'].

path_seed_points.description: Ordered drill-path waypoints in body coordinates.
path_seed_points.title: Path Seed Points

skills.name: core_cavity_split
skills.summary: Split the body into core and cavity halves at a parting plane via BRepAlgoAPI_Common with two half-spaces. Body is returned unchanged; the two solids are exposed in result.extras ('core_solid', 'cavity_solid').

skills.name: draft_apply_auto
skills.summary: Apply automatic draft (BRepOffsetAPI_DraftAngle) to all near-vertical faces relative to the pull direction. Faces above the neutral plane (parting_z or body top) stay still; faces below taper inward by min_draft_deg.

skills.name: ejector_pin_clearance
skills.summary: Drill ejector pin holes (cylindrical clearances) at the given XY positions on the cavity-side face. Each pin is a cylinder of pin_diameter_mm diameter, pin_depth_mm deep, with its top at z = z_start_mm, removed from the body via boolean cut.

skills.name: ejector_pin_pattern
skills.summary: Distribute ejector pin positions evenly across the selected face via Lloyd's relaxation (5 iterations). Reports positions only — body is unchanged. Use ejector_pin_clearance to actually drill the holes.

skills.name: parting_surface
skills.summary: Generate a planar parting surface at the given Z plane (rectangle minus body cross-section). Body is returned unchanged; the surface shape is exposed via result.extras['parting_surface_shape'] for downstream mold-tooling skills (core/cavity split, etc.).

skills.name: runner_diameter_calc
skills.summary: Recommend an injection-molding runner diameter via the empirical D = 0.2654 * sqrt(mass_g) * L_mm^0.148 rule. Pure calculation — body is unchanged. Result in extras['runner_recommendation'].

skills.name: slide_action_geometry
skills.summary: Build a slide-action tooling block sized to release a single undercut face. The block's parting plane is perpendicular to the undercut normal with slide_clearance_mm offset. Returns the slide block as the new body and records parting plane info in extras.

skills.name: breathing_hole_array
skills.summary: Hex-packed array of small through-holes clipped to a region sketch on a planar face. Used for speaker meshes, mic vents, breathing membranes. v1 supports planar +Z/-Z faces.

Arc from start to end on a circle of `radius`, direction selected by `ccw`.

Validation: chord length ≤ 2·radius.
ArcSegment.title: ArcSegment

BSplineSketch.description:
Closed periodic B-spline interpolating through `fit_points`.

Built via `GeomAPI_Interpolate(points, PeriodicFlag=True, tol)`.
BSplineSketch.title: BSplineSketch

CompositeSketch.description:
Closed loop made of line/arc/spline segments.

Segments are validated to form a closed chain: end of segment i must equal
start of segment i+1 (within EPS_CLOSE), and last.end == first.start.
CompositeSketch.title: CompositeSketch

LissajousCurveSketch.description:
Closed Lissajous figure (shorthand for a common parametric curve).

x(t) = amp_x · sin(freq_x · t + phase)
y(t) = amp_y · sin(freq_y · t)
t ∈ [0, 2π].

With integer freq_x / freq_y and a non-zero phase the curve is closed
(lobes form a figure 8 / star). Always built as a periodic spline.
LissajousCurveSketch.title: LissajousCurveSketch

ParametricCurveSketch.description:
Parametric curve x(t), y(t) sampled in [t_min, t_max].

Both `x_expr` and `y_expr` are simpleeval expressions in variable `t`.
Allowed funcs: sin/cos/tan/exp/sqrt/abs; consts: pi, e.
The sampled points are interpolated as a periodic B-spline if
`close_curve` is True (typical for closed-loop sketches), otherwise as a
non-periodic spline whose first/last endpoints will be auto-closed with a
short tangent segment by the wire builder.
ParametricCurveSketch.title: ParametricCurveSketch

PolarCurveSketch.description:
Polar curve r(theta) sampled in [theta_min, theta_max].

`r_expr` is a simpleeval expression in variable `theta`. The sampled
points (x = r·cos θ, y = r·sin θ) are always closed (periodic spline).
PolarCurveSketch.title: PolarCurveSketch

PolygonSketch.description:
Closed polygon defined by ≥3 vertices. Last vertex auto-connects to first.

`corner_fillet_r` > 0 applies a uniform 2D fillet on every vertex via
BRepFilletAPI_MakeFillet2d.
PolygonSketch.title: PolygonSketch

SlotSketch.description:
Capsule shape: two semicircular end caps joined by two straight lines.

`length_mm` is the overall length including end caps.
`width_mm` is the diameter of the end caps (also the slot width).
SlotSketch.title: SlotSketch

region_sketch.description: 2D region (in face-local coords; center at face center) inside which to place breathing holes.
region_sketch.title: Region Sketch

skills.name: cable_routing_channel
skills.summary: Semi-circular cable-routing channel swept along a polyline on a planar face. Used to seat a cable inside a housing so it doesn't rattle. v1 supports planar +Z/-Z target faces.

path_points.description: ≥2 face-local (x, y) points (in mm). Origin at face center.

skills.summary: Class-A highlight-line view. Parallel virtual lights along the view_direction reflect off every face — sharp angle jumps in the reflected ray between adjacent samples mark highlight-line breaks (G1/G2 discontinuities). Read-only — body unchanged.

skills.name: zebra_stripe_view
skills.summary: Class-A zebra-stripe view. Virtual parallel stripes projected along view_direction reveal where adjacent faces meet with a G1 discontinuity (the stripes bend at the shared edge). Read-only — body unchanged.

skills.name: continuity_audit
skills.summary: Class-A continuity audit. For every shared edge between two faces, certify positional (G0), tangent (G1), or curvature (G2) continuity and list every edge that fails the requested minimum. Read-only — body unchanged.

skills.name: enforce_min_tool_radius
skills.summary: CNC DFM check — every concave internal edge must have a fillet radius >= min_radius_mm (the cutter cannot reach a sharper corner). With auto_fix=True, sub-threshold edges are auto-filleted; otherwise they are reported as violations.

min_radius_mm.description: Minimum internal-corner fillet radius (= cutter radius).
min_radius_mm.title: Min Radius Mm

auto_fix.description: True → auto-fillet sub-threshold edges. False → report violations only.
auto_fix.title: Auto Fix

skills.name: tool_reachability
skills.summary: For each detected pocket, verify the cutter can physically reach it from the chosen setup direction: depth/diameter <= max_aspect_ratio AND the approach ray is not blocked by other geometry. Read-only — body unchanged.

tool_diameter_mm.description: Diameter of the cutter being checked (mm).
tool_diameter_mm.title: Tool Diameter Mm

max_aspect_ratio.description: Allowed depth/diameter ratio. Above this the tool deflects / chatters / breaks.
max_aspect_ratio.title: Max Aspect Ratio

setup_direction.description: Unit vector pointing OUT of the part along the tool approach axis. Default +Z (top of stock).
setup_direction.title: Setup Direction

skills.name: pocket_aspect_ratio_check
skills.summary: For each detected pocket compute depth / min_in_plane_dimension and flag pockets above the threshold. Tool-independent — answers 'is the pocket geometry itself too deep for its width?'. Read-only — body unchanged.

max_aspect_ratio.description: depth/min_dimension threshold; pockets above are flagged for redesign or alternative process.
max_aspect_ratio.title: Max Aspect Ratio

skills.name: gear_helical_involute
skills.summary: Helical external spur gear with kinematically correct involute tooth profile and constant helix-angle twist. Standard module / pressure-angle / helix-angle parameterization (ISO).

skills.name: worm_thread
skills.summary: Cylindrical worm shaft with a single-start helical V-thread. Standard module + lead-angle parameterization; axial pitch px = π·m/cos(γ). Produces a true 3D thread (not decorative).

skills.name: close_shell_to_solid
skills.summary: Wrap the body's shell(s) with BRepBuilderAPI_MakeSolid to form a TopoDS_Solid. No-op when no usable shell is found.

skills.name: remove_micro_features
skills.summary: Approximate removal of sub-`min_size_mm` features — drives a ShapeFix_Shape + per-wire FixSmall pass at tolerance=min_size_mm. Documented approximation: short edges merge, slivers vanish; true defeaturing of small fillets is NOT performed.

skills.name: sew_faces_to_shell
skills.summary: Sew loose faces of the body into a connected shell using BRepBuilderAPI_Sewing. Returns the sewn shape (shell or compound).

skills.name: shape_heal
skills.summary: Run OCCT ShapeFix_Shape on the body — closes small gaps, fixes wire/edge issues, optionally reorients faces. Returns the healed body plus extras['heal_report'] with per-stage counts.

skills.name: simplify_to_canonical
skills.summary: Merge co-domain adjacent faces/edges using ShapeUpgrade_UnifySameDomain (UnifyFaces=True, UnifyEdges=True, ConcatBSplines=True).

skills.name: face_adjacency_graph
skills.summary: Build the topology graph of the body — for every pair of faces sharing an edge, record the shared edge length and the dihedral concavity (convex / concave / tangent). Result on extras['face_graph']; body unchanged.

skills.name: edge_concavity_classify
skills.summary: Classify every edge of the body by the dihedral angle of its adjacent faces — convex (<180°), concave (>180°), or tangent (≈180°). Result on extras['edge_concavity']; body unchanged.

skills.name: vertex_connectivity
skills.summary: For each unique vertex, list its position, degree, and incident edge indices (same order as the body's enumerated edge list). Result on extras['vertices']; body unchanged.

skills.name: fit_plane
skills.summary: Best-fit plane (origin + normal + residual) from face samples. Short-circuits to OCCT analytic plane when face is GeomAbs_Plane. Read-only — body unchanged.

skills.name: fit_cylinder
skills.summary: Best-fit cylinder (axis + radius + residual) from face samples. Short-circuits to OCCT analytic cylinder when face is GeomAbs_Cylinder. Read-only — body unchanged.

skills.name: fit_sphere
skills.summary: Best-fit sphere (center + radius + residual) from face samples. Short-circuits to OCCT analytic sphere when face is GeomAbs_Sphere. Read-only — body unchanged.

skills.name: fit_cone
skills.summary: Best-fit cone (apex + axis + half-angle + residual) from face samples. Short-circuits to OCCT analytic cone when face is GeomAbs_Cone. Read-only — body unchanged.

skills.name: fit_torus
skills.summary: Best-fit torus (center + axis + major/minor radius + residual) from face samples. Short-circuits to OCCT analytic torus when face is GeomAbs_Torus. Read-only — body unchanged.

skills.name: classify_pockets
skills.summary: Detect and classify every pocket / hole / cavity on the body — blind, through, stepped, conical, or spherical. Connects cylindrical, conical, spherical and interior-planar faces into pocket clusters via the face adjacency graph, then inspects surface types and planar floor levels for the type tag. Read-only — body unchanged.

min_depth_mm.description: Pockets whose measured depth is below this threshold are filtered out (noise / chamfer-like creases).
min_depth_mm.title: Min Depth Mm

skills.name: classify_holes
skills.summary: Detect and classify every cylindrical hole on the body — simple, counterbore, countersink, counterdrill, spotface, or threaded. Optionally match each against the metric/imperial thread catalogs and report the closest spec by diameter. Read-only — body unchanged.

match_standards.description: If True, look the hole's primary diameter up against catalogs/standards/threads_metric.yaml (and threads_imperial.yaml when present) and attach the closest standard spec to each descriptor.
match_standards.title: Match Standards

skills.name: detect_bosses
skills.summary: Detect boss-like outward protrusions on the body by finding the dominant base plane and grouping the faces that stand above it. Each cluster is classified cylindrical / prismatic / conical and reported with center, height, and cross-section. Body unchanged.

min_height_mm.description: Reject clusters whose extent perpendicular to the base plane is shorter than this.
min_height_mm.title: Min Height Mm

skills.name: detect_ribs
skills.summary: Detect thin-wall stiffening ribs — prismatic boss clusters whose bbox is long-and-thin (length / thickness > min ratio and thickness < max). Wraps detect_bosses + aspect-ratio filter.

min_aspect_ratio.description: length / thickness ratio above which a thin block is considered a rib (rather than a cube-ish boss).
min_aspect_ratio.title: Min Aspect Ratio

max_thickness_mm.description: Maximum thickness (shortest bbox extent) for the cluster to qualify as a rib.
max_thickness_mm.title: Max Thickness Mm

skills.name: detect_standoffs
skills.summary: Detect standoffs — cylindrical bosses with a central concentric hole. Pairs detect_bosses output with find_features hole entries by collinear axes.

skills.name: detect_lugs
skills.summary: Detect strap-lug pairs — two standoffs (boss + through-hole) whose pin axes are parallel and lie side-by-side perpendicular to that axis (watch-strap pattern).

skills.name: detect_mirror_symmetry
skills.summary: Detect mirror-symmetry planes by reflecting a sampled point cloud of the body and comparing to the original. Supports axis-aligned XZ/YZ/XY tests and PCA-derived 'auto' planes. Body unchanged.

skills.name: detect_rotational_symmetry
skills.summary: Detect rotational-symmetry axes by rotating a sampled point cloud by 360°/n for n in [2, max_order] about candidate axes (X/Y/Z or PCA 'auto') and scoring agreement with the original. Body unchanged.

min_score.description: Drop (axis, order) pairs whose score is below this.
min_score.title: Min Score

skills.name: detect_linear_array
skills.summary: Detect linear arrays (3+ same-kind features collinear and equi-spaced) of holes, pockets or bosses. Each run is reported with its ordered positions, direction, spacing, and count. Body unchanged.

skills.name: detect_circular_array
skills.summary: Detect circular arrays (features distributed on a circle with equal angular pitch). Reports the centre, axis, radius, count, and angular pitch of each ring. Body unchanged.

skills.name: match_standard_hole
skills.summary: Look a measured hole diameter up against the metric/imperial thread catalogs and return the top 3 closest standard specs by diameter proximity. Read-only — body unchanged.

skills.name: match_standard_bearing
skills.summary: Match a measured bearing (any subset of outer Ø / bore Ø / width) against the metric deep-groove ball bearing catalog and return the top 3 closest standard designations. Read-only — body unchanged.

skills.name: match_standard_oring
skills.summary: Match a measured O-ring (cross-section + inner Ø) against the AS568 catalog and return the top 3 closest dash sizes. Read-only — body unchanged.

skills.name: identify_fastener_recess
skills.summary: Identify a fastener driver recess (hex / torx / phillips) by inspecting the outline of the selected planar face, then look the closest catalog size up in drivers.yaml. Read-only — body unchanged.

skills.name: extract_feature_catalog
skills.summary: Aggregate every feature detector (classify_holes / classify_pockets / detect_bosses / detect_ribs / detect_lugs / detect_mirror_symmetry / detect_linear_array / detect_circular_array / match_standard_hole) into a single feature_catalog dict on result.extras. Body unchanged.

skills.name: plan_from_feature_catalog
skills.summary: Convert a feature_catalog (from extract_feature_catalog) into an ordered Plan YAML of build skills (base box → pockets → bosses → lugs → ribs → patterns → holes). Writes plans/reconstructed_plan.yaml and attaches the plan to extras['generated_plan']. Body unchanged.

skills.name: auto_dimension
skills.summary: Detect key dimensions automatically (overall bbox, wall thicknesses, hole spacings, shaft/hole diameters and heights). Each entry has name/value/unit/tolerance. Read-only.

skills.name: cross_section_at_features
skills.summary: Automatically select interesting cutting planes (bbox midplanes, planes through hole axes, planes through pattern centers) and summarise each cross section. Read-only.

skills.name: auto_datum_planes
skills.summary: Identify the three best datum planes (A/B/C) of a body: largest planar face = A, largest perpendicular planar = B, third orthogonal = C. Stores face indices in extras['datums']. Read-only.

skills.name: principal_axes
skills.summary: Compute principal axes (PCA on mass) of the body via eigen-decomposition of OCCT's inertia tensor. Returns up to 3 axes sorted by moment ascending. Read-only.

skills.name: overhang_check
skills.summary: Flag overhang faces for FDM/SLA printing. For each face, compute the angle between the outward face normal and -build_direction; faces past max_angle_deg are reported as needing support. Read-only — body unchanged.

skills.name: support_volume_estimate
skills.summary: Estimate total support material volume needed to print the body by projecting every overhang face down to the build plate and multiplying projected area by drop height and support density. Read-only — body unchanged.

skills.name: bridge_length_check
skills.summary: Find horizontal edges that span an unsupported gap (bridges) and flag any whose length exceeds max_bridge_mm. Bridges longer than ~10 mm are unreliable on FDM without supports. Read-only.

horizontal_tol_deg.description: how far from horizontal an edge tangent may tilt and still count as a bridge
horizontal_tol_deg.title: Horizontal Tol Deg

support_gap_mm.description: if there is solid material this close beneath the edge midpoint, the edge is *supported*
support_gap_mm.title: Support Gap Mm

skills.name: orientation_optimize
skills.summary: Try several build directions and pick the best one by combined score over overhang_count, support_volume and max bridge length. Lower score is better. Read-only — body unchanged.

skills.name: add_support_brim
skills.summary: Add a thin rectangular brim around a planar base face for FDM build-plate adhesion. The brim extends brim_width_mm outward from the face bounding box and is brim_height_mm tall along the outward face normal. v1: planar +Z / -Z target faces only.

skills.name: gating_position_candidates
skills.summary: Rank candidate gating positions for an injection-molded part by flow length and cosmetic visibility. Returns the top num_candidates faces with shortest flow path that are NOT on the A-surface. Read-only — body unchanged.

viewer_position.description: Viewer position passed through to cosmetic_side_classify.
viewer_position.title: Viewer Position

skills.name: datum_target_assign
skills.summary: Tag face(s) as an ISO 5459 datum target (A..F, precedence 1/2/3..., kind point/line/area). Stored on body._pd_datums for downstream FCF / GD&T resolution. Read-only — body unchanged.

skills.name: basic_dimension_attach
skills.summary: Attach a basic (theoretically-exact) dimension between two entities (distance/angle/diameter/radius/arc_length). If no nominal supplied, measure on-body. Stored on body._pd_basic_dims. Read-only.

skills.name: projected_tolerance_zone
skills.summary: ISO 1101 projected tolerance zone (⊕P) — tag a cylindrical hole face with projection_length / tolerance metadata so the position tolerance is enforced at a virtual axis extension. Read-only.

skills.name: mmc_lmc_modifier
skills.summary: Tag a feature face with a material-condition modifier (MMC Ⓜ / LMC Ⓛ / RFS Ⓢ) per ISO 2692, recording the measured feature size for bonus-tolerance computation. Read-only.

skills.name: runout_check
skills.summary: GD&T circular & total runout (ISO 1101) — sample points on a surface, project to a rotating axis, compute per-slice (r_max−r_min) and global FIM. Read-only — body unchanged.

skills.name: feature_control_frame_compose
skills.summary: Compose an ISO 1101 / ASME Y14.5 Feature Control Frame (geom_char + tolerance + modifiers + datum refs). Appended to body._pd_fcf and returned in extras['fcf']. Read-only.

skills.name: exploded_view
skills.summary: Translate each component of a multi-body assembly outward (radial / axial / custom) to produce an exploded view. Offsets are recorded in result.extras['exploded_offsets'].

explode_distance_mm.description: component 마다 i*explode_distance 만큼 outward translate.
explode_distance_mm.title: Explode Distance Mm

custom_direction.description: direction='custom' 일 때 사용. 단위 벡터로 정규화됨.
custom_direction.title: Custom Direction

skills.name: sub_assembly_tag
skills.summary: Tag a set of components as belonging to a named sub-assembly. Body geometry is unchanged; membership is recorded in result.extras['sub_assemblies'].

component_names.description: 이 sub-assembly 에 묶을 component 이름들.
component_names.title: Component Names

skills.name: auto_place_fasteners
skills.summary: Detect collinear cylindrical hole pairs between two named components and add a fastener (cylinder) body at each pair. Thread spec (e.g. M3) drives the fastener outer diameter via the metric thread catalog.

skills.name: bolt_pattern_recognize
skills.summary: Find cylindrical hole centres on the given face(s) and classify their layout as linear / circular / grid / random. Result is attached to result.extras['bolt_pattern']; body is unchanged.

face_selector.description: Planar face whose hole positions are to be analyzed.
face_selector.title: Face Selector

radius_filter_min_mm.description: If set, only cylinders with radius >= this are used.
radius_filter_min_mm.title: Radius Filter Min Mm

radius_filter_max_mm.description: If set, only cylinders with radius <= this are used.
radius_filter_max_mm.title: Radius Filter Max Mm

skills.name: check_clearance_full
skills.summary: Exact pairwise body-body minimum distance check on a multi-body assembly. Reports every pair whose distance is below min_clearance_mm in result.extras['clearance_violations']. Body unchanged.

min_clearance_mm.description: 허용 최소 간격. 이 값보다 가까운 pair 는 violation 으로 기록.
min_clearance_mm.title: Min Clearance Mm

pair_filter.description: 검사할 (a,b) 이름 쌍. None 이면 모든 pair.
pair_filter.title: Pair Filter

skills.name: catalog_lookup
skills.summary: Look up a single spec from a typed catalog YAML (family/name/spec) and attach the validated entry to extras['catalog_entry']. Read-only — body unchanged.

spec.description: key inside the YAML entries dict
spec.title: Spec

skills.name: catalog_search
skills.summary: Find specs in a catalog family whose names contain the query substring (case insensitive). Returns ranked matches across every YAML in the family. Read-only — body unchanged.

query.description: substring to match against spec names
query.title: Query

skills.name: suggest_selector_from_phrase
skills.summary: Translate a natural-language phrase (e.g., 'the top face', 'all cylindrical holes', 'vertical edges') into the most likely selector JSON tree(s). Heuristic; returns top_k ranked suggestions with confidence and reasoning. No body mutation.

skills.name: predict_post_conditions
skills.summary: Estimate the volume delta and predict pass/fail of each declared post_condition for a target skill, given the current body volume and proposed args. Closed-form heuristic for hole / pocket / plateau / through; otherwise sign derived from post_conditions.

skills.name: explain_skill_failure
skills.summary: Diagnose a failed Plan step from its failure message (and optionally the source plan YAML). Returns likely_cause + suggested_fix + a list of follow-up inspect skills the LLM should run to confirm. Read-only.

skills.name: find_similar_skills
skills.summary: Given a registered skill name, return the top_k other skills with the highest similarity by keyword overlap of name+summary and category proximity. Helpful when the LLM needs alternative verbs (e.g., extrude_pocket → extrude_through, swept_pocket_*).

skills.name: plan_diff
skills.summary: Compare two Plan YAML files step-by-step and return a list of diff entries describing added / removed / skill_changed / args_changed / unchanged steps. Includes per-field arg diff for args_changed entries. Read-only.

skills.name: face_tessellate
skills.summary: Tessellate the body with BRepMesh_IncrementalMesh at the given linear deflection and extract triangles + per-vertex normals for each face matched by the selector. Read-only — body unchanged.

skills.name: edge_polyline_extract
skills.summary: Sample N+1 points uniformly along each edge matched by the selector and return the resulting polylines for wire-frame viz or geometric walking. Read-only — body unchanged.

skills.name: curvature_at_point
skills.summary: Compute Gaussian / mean / principal curvatures at a single normalised (u, v) location on the first matched face. Read-only — body unchanged.

skills.name: normal_map_compute
skills.summary: For every face on the body, sample N points on a UV grid and compute the unit outward normal at each. Result is a normal map suitable for shaded viz / draft-angle checks. Read-only — body unchanged.

skills.name: color_by_property
skills.summary: Tag every face with a scalar value drawn from a physical / geometric property (wall_thickness, draft_angle, curvature, stress) and map it through a colormap to per-face RGB. Drives heat-map viz / DFM overlays. Read-only — body unchanged.
